cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline compiler diagnostics and Kiswahili code-switching support a hint-first programming tutor.

test_prompts.prompt:
Implement the Python function get_positive(l). Preserve this exact function name and argument contract. Requirement: Return only positive numbers in the list. >>> get_positive([-1, 2, -4, 5, 6]) [2, 5, 6] >>> get_positive([5, 3, -5, 2, -3, 3, 9, 0, 123, 1, -10]) [5, 3, 2, 3, 9, 123, 1]

Respond in English. Return exactly one fenced python code block containing the complete implementation. After the block, add one short English sentence explaining the approach. Do not include tests.

Tekeleza Python function triangle_area(a, h). Hifadhi function name na argument contract hizi bila kubadilisha. Mahitaji: Kutokana na urefu wa upande na eneo kubwa la kurudi kwa triangle. >>> triangle_area(5, 3) 7.5 Technical terms zihifadhiwe: function.

Jibu kwa Kiswahili. Toa kizuizi kimoja tu cha msimbo wa python chenye utekelezaji kamili. Baada ya kizuizi, ongeza sentensi moja fupi ya Kiswahili inayoeleza mbinu. Usijumuishe majaribio.
